package section

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/relationorder"
)

// AddSectionLessonInput links a lesson to a section.
type AddSectionLessonInput struct {
	SectionID string
	LessonID  string
	Order     int
}

// AddSectionLesson adds or updates a section-lesson placement.
type AddSectionLesson struct {
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	SectionLessons repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle validates and persists the relation.
func (uc AddSectionLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, in AddSectionLessonInput) error {
	if in.SectionID == "" || in.LessonID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if uc.Sections != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, in.SectionID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.Lessons != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, in.LessonID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.SectionLessons == nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return uc.SectionLessons.Add(ctx, in.SectionID, in.LessonID, in.Order)
	})
}

// DeleteSectionLesson removes a section-lesson placement.
type DeleteSectionLesson struct {
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	SectionLessons repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

// ReplaceSectionLessons atomically replaces the complete ordered lesson set
// of one section.
type ReplaceSectionLessons struct {
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	SectionLessons repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceSectionLessons) Handle(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	sectionID, items, err := relationorder.Normalize(sectionID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, sectionID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.SectionLessons.ReplaceBySection(ctx, sectionID, items)
	})
}

// Handle validates and deletes the relation.
func (uc DeleteSectionLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, lessonID string) error {
	if sectionID == "" || lessonID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if uc.Sections != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, sectionID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.Lessons != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.SectionLessons == nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return uc.SectionLessons.Delete(ctx, sectionID, lessonID)
	})
}
